_note: Authored catalogue words for each design (ADR 0156): description, slug, industries, occasions, style, colour, family, aliases. Industries, occasions, style and colour were seeded from names, setups, collections and tokens on 2026-10-20 and need review; descriptions are written by the design author. Labels live in taxonomy, never in the plugin.
